# relationship derivation between entities

Derives relationships such as contains, depends_on, defined_in, covers, implemented_by/governs/affects from observed components, APIs, tests, and candidate entities. Containment is derived from component path prefixes over the union of observed and current components so PR slices do not drop containment edges to out-of-scope children.
